reasons.A: Several lineage sections are truncated: '직접 주입의 체계화: PromptInject' (L63-67) stops after definitions with no results; 'PoisonedRAG' (L162-164) is one paragraph; '도구 악용, MCP, 멀티 에이전트 공격' (L166-179) ends after the four-part Prompt Infection list, so AiTM, MCP vectors, ETDI and ToolHijacker get no subsection. HouYi, Greshake, BadAgent and RAGForensics never get their own treatment and Jailbroken (2307.02483) is never cited. Table cells '-' (L497, L511). Conditional written with '|' (L77, L430). Reference venues copied garbled (L545, L554-L558).
reasons.B: Fluent, consistent 입니다 register with established terms. Minor noun frames and passives: '침해할 수 있다는 점을 보입니다' (L51), '몫으로 해석됩니다' (L205); formulaic '식으로 쓰면 아래와 같습니다' (L131). Long prose in table cells (L496-L509).
reasons.C: Good opening map of six lineages (L17-L31), but sections end abruptly (L67->L69, L164->L166, L179->L181) and PoisonedRAG is introduced at L162 then explained at L444 under another heading. Facts repeated: adaptive attack '8개 방어를 모두 우회' at L19, L52, L301, L482, L517, L533; CaMeL summary at L27, L53, L521, L535; lethal trifecta at L15, L488, L521.
reasons.D: Strong where present: GCG loss, candidate selection and three-step loop (L77-L93), PAIR objective (L133-L135), CaMeL capability pseudo-code labelled as illustrative (L258-L276), InjecAgent ASR-valid denominator explained (L321-L323). No help for the missing lineages.
reasons.E: 16 figures, each read descriptively; useful defense comparison table (L294-L299) and benchmark table (L411-L418); PAIR vs GCG efficiency table copied from source (L147-L152). Main comparison table cells are prose and two are '-' (L497, L511).
reasons.F: Numbers are almost all correct (24/26 sampled). Wrong: SecAlign 'utility loss unknown' (L241, L298) although the paper reports AlpacaEval2 WinRate within 0.7%; reference venues wrong or garbled: Prompt Infection 'Lecture notes in computer science' (L558), AgentDojo 'Zenodo (CERN...)' (L555), Greshake 'CISPA Helmholtz Center' (L545), lowercase 'neural information processing systems' (L556). ToolHijacker limitation cell holds a result (L511).
reasons.S1: Limitation cells: ToolHijacker cell is the defense-failure finding (L511); SecAlign 'limitation' is an input artefact ('비슷한 수준이라고만 밝혀서', L241). Cells are long prose sentences rather than noun phrases (L496-L509); Indirect PI and ToolHijacker results '-'. The adaptive-attack result is re-explained in multiple sections.

reasons.A: All 24 plan papers are covered and each lineage has substantive subsections, but the final results table comes after the three subsections that discuss it ('아래 표는' L726, table at L746); a one-row table with the citation on its own line (L708-L712); thin sections '수작업에서 의미 수준 자동화로' (L234-L236) and '탈옥 최적화에서...' (L698-L700); raw TeX '\hskip 5.69046pt' and \displaystyle in an equation (L310).
reasons.B: Natural 입니다 register, but nearly every sentence carries the same citation (e.g. eight '([Perez et al., 2022])' in L54-L70), which hurts reading; '이 글의 해석/관점' is used repeatedly (L220, L230, L468, L484, L588, L692, L720); mixed terminology 인젝션/주입 (L48 vs L368) and 유용성/유틸리티 (L580 vs L738); '첫 번째 핵심 메시지는 짧습니다' (L113) is awkward.
reasons.C: The email-assistant running example (L15) ties every lineage together. However, there are back-references to content the post never gives: '앞서 본 대로 성공률이 가장 높은 쪽은 전송 단계였습니다' (L606), '앞서 소개한 현실적인 과제와 보안 테스트 케이스' (L634), '앞서 본 대로' (L652, L666), '앞서 소개한 비율대로' (L678), '앞서 다룬 Claude Sonnet 모델' (L684). L149 and L153 describe an overview figure and paired bars that are not shown.
reasons.D: Hard parts get help when they appear: inverse scaling defined (L70), GCG explained before the adaptive-attack loss (L131), the loss variables filled in with the email example (L139), CaMeL control- vs data-flow attacks contrasted on the example (L564), ROP defined (L791). A few example applications feel mechanical (L376, L434).
reasons.E: 49 figures, each placed where discussed and read descriptively, with formulas for PoisonedRAG, AgentPoison, MCP tool poisoning, AiTM and SecAlign. Weak points: a one-row 'table' (L708-L710), some figure paragraphs only restate the caption (L384, L420, L507), and the adaptive-attack figure is described but missing (L149-L153).
reasons.F: 30 claims sampled, 2 wrong. L13 credits PromptInject's and Greshake's findings to '(Lee et al., 2024)' (Prompt Infection) instead of the original papers. L756 gives '파인튜닝 GPT-4 InjecAgent ASR 3.8%', but in InjecAgent Table 3 3.8% is the fine-tuned GPT-3.5 row (GPT-4 is 6.6%). Minor: the L751 Jailbroken cell mixes the curated (0.94) and synthetic (0.96) datasets without saying so; SecAlign '1%와 8%' (L761) has no model attribution.
reasons.S1: Cells are noun phrases in Korean, and limitations are mostly the papers' own (L749-L768). Exceptions: the ToolHijacker limitation 'ToolBench 라이브러리 크기에 따른 ASR 차이' (L769) is a result; 'PromptInject: 프롬프트 인젝션 방어 한계' (L748) is vague; 'ASR 100.0' has no unit (L758). Little re-explanation.

A.reason: Y covers all 24 papers with real subsections; X truncates three lineages and omits Jailbroken.

B.reason: X reads more cleanly; Y cites the same paper on almost every sentence and mixes 인젝션/주입 and 유용성/유틸리티.

C.reason: Y's running example ties the post together. Its broken back-references are a smaller problem than X's abrupt section ends and repeated facts.

D.reason: Both explain hard mechanisms well; Y does it for every lineage and grounds formulas in the running example.

E.reason: Y has more relevant figures and formulas across lineages; X has better defense and benchmark comparison tables but '-' cells.

F.reason: Lower sampled error rate (2/30 vs 3/26); X adds a false SecAlign limitation and garbled venues.

S1.reason: Y's limitation cells are mostly the papers' own, as noun phrases; X has prose cells, '-' cells and two input- or result-based limitations.

overall.reason: Y is complete and better connected, at the cost of citation clutter and broken cross-references; X is precise where it goes deep but structurally incomplete.
